Subject: Request: expired trial credits for InterOp POC

Hi Dylan,

Quick one — our POC with Redwood was paused in June when our security team put the SOC2 onboarding on hold. We had about 60k tokens left in the sandbox, which expired last week. The evaluation was going well and the product team needs to pick up where we left off.

Can you do a one-time reissue of credits (or a short extension) so we can finish the final integration tests? Ideally something in the 15k-25k token range and valid at least 30 days. If you need a short form or an internal approval, attach what you need and I’ll get it back same day.

Also looping in my colleague Alex (cc’d) who’s running the integration.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Head of Integrations | InterOp Solutions
samira@interop.solutions
+1 (415) 555-0186

Hi Samira — thanks for the context and the SOC notes. I’m glad the POC had momentum.

Short answer: we can often approve a one-time top-up for situations like this. Two quick asks so I can route for approval:
- Confirm target token amount you want (15k–25k ok?) and whether you expect peak runs (short burst vs continuous load).
- Confirm that the only blocker was the SOC2 gating and you expect a go/no-go decision within 30 days.

I’ve attached a short form (trial_reactivation_request.xlsx) we use for approvals — if you can fill the expected usage numbers and sign-off line from your security manager, that speeds things up. If you want, I can provisionally request 15k so you don’t lose time.

Provisional plan: I’ll ask Marissa for a one-time 15k token credit (30-day expiry) while we confirm. If you need 25k we’ll escalate to Ben for an exception.

—Dylan
